strings.Bridges and buildings: load paths, const: Amabhuloho nezakhiwo: izindlela zomthwalo, ukwakha nokuqinisekisa.
strings.Each course has 5 stages and 40 steps: l: Isifundo ngasinye sinezigaba ezingu-5 nezinyathelo ezingu-40: imithwalo nohlelo lwesakhiwo, izinto nokuxhumana, ukwakha nokulawula izigaba, ukuhlola nokuqapha, ukuqina nokudluliselwa; iyunithi ngayinye ihlukaniswe ibe yindlela yomthwalo, isibalo, ukuqinisekisa nokuxilonga ukwehluleka. Kusukela ku-Akashi Kaikyō Bridge naku-Millau Viaduct kuya ku-Taipei 101, Burj Khalifa ne-Sydney Opera House, kanye nezibalo ezibalulekile, imigqa yesikhathi, amakhodi nokuqhathanisa amaphrojekthi adumile. Isigaba sokuqala sesifundo ngasinye simahhala.
strings.Explore {n} bridge and building subdisci: Hlola imikhakha engaphansi engu-{n} yamabhuloho nezakhiwo
strings.100 guided courses on suspension, cable-: Izifundo eziqondisiwe ezingu-100 ngamabhuloho alengayo, amabhuloho asekelwa ngamakhebuli namabhuloho angamakhothamo, ukuwela ulwandle, imibhoshongo emide kakhulu, uphahla olunezikhala ezinde, ukunciphisa ukudlidliza, ukuklama okumelana nokuzamazama komhlaba, ubuso bezakhiwo nokwakha ngedijithali.
strings.Load paths, construction stages and meas: Izindlela zomthwalo, izigaba zokwakha nokuqinisekisa okulinganisiwe kuxhumanisa izifundo; amabhuloho nezakhiwo kusebenzisa ukuhlanganiswa kwemithwalo, amakhodi nemibandela yokwamukela ehlukene.
